11.english_reference: with the filthiness of the people of the lands

traditions.WLC: בְּ נִדַּ֖ת עַמֵּ֣י הָ אֲרָצ֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: ἐν μετακινήσει λαῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν ,
traditions.VUL: iuxta immundítiam populórum , ceterarúmque terrárum ,
traditions.KJV: with the filthiness of the people of the lands ,

traditions.WLC: בְּ תוֹעֲבֹֽתֵי הֶ֗ם
traditions.LXX: ἐν μακρύμμασιν αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: abominatiónibus eórum
traditions.KJV: with their abominations ,

11.english_reference: which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלְא֛וּ הָ מִ פֶּ֥ה אֶל פֶּ֖ה בְּ טֻמְאָתָֽ ם
traditions.LXX: ὧν ἔπλησαν αὐτὴν ἀπὸ στόματος ἐπὶ στόμα ἐν ἀκαθαρσίαις αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: qui replevérunt eam ab ore usque ad os in coinquinatióne sua .
traditions.KJV: which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness .

12.english_reference: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ עַתָּה בְּֽנוֹתֵי כֶ֞ם אַל תִּתְּנ֣וּ לִ בְנֵי הֶ֗ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν τὰς θυγατέρας ὑμῶν μὴ δῶτε τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Nunc ergo fílias vestras ne detis fíliis eórum ,
traditions.KJV: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons ,

12.english_reference: neither take their daughters unto your sons

traditions.WLC: וּ בְנֹֽתֵי הֶם֙ אַל תִּשְׂא֣וּ לִ בְנֵי כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπὸ θυγατέρων αὐτῶν μὴ λάβητε τοῖς υἱοῖς ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et fílias eórum ne accipiátis fíliis vestris ,
traditions.KJV: neither take their daughters unto your sons ,

12.english_reference: nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא תִדְרְשׁ֧וּ שְׁלֹמָ֛ ם וְ טוֹבָתָ֖ ם עַד עוֹלָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἐκζητήσετε εἰρήνην αὐτῶν καὶ ἀγαθὸν αὐτῶν ἕως αἰῶνος ,
traditions.VUL: et non quærátis pacem eórum et prosperitátem eórum usque in ætérnum :
traditions.KJV: nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever :

traditions.WLC: לְמַ֣עַן תֶּחֶזְק֗וּ
traditions.LXX: ὅπως ἐνισχύσητε
traditions.VUL: ut confortémini ,
traditions.KJV: that ye may be strong ,

12.english_reference: and eat the good of the land

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲכַלְתֶּם֙ אֶת ט֣וּב הָ אָ֔רֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ φάγητε τὰ ἀγαθὰ τῆς γῆς
traditions.VUL: et comedátis quæ bona sunt terræ ,
traditions.KJV: and eat the good of the land ,

12.english_reference: and leave [ it ] for an inheritance to your children for ever

traditions.WLC: וְ הוֹרַשְׁתֶּ֥ם לִ בְנֵי כֶ֖ם עַד עוֹלָֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κληροδοτήσητε τοῖς υἱοῖς ὑμῶν ἕως αἰῶνος .
traditions.VUL: et herédes habeátis fílios vestros usque in sǽculum .
traditions.KJV: and leave [ it ] for an inheritance to your children for ever .

13.english_reference: And after all that is come upon us

traditions.WLC: וְ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ כָּל הַ בָּ֣א עָלֵ֔י נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ μετὰ πᾶν τὸ ἐρχόμενον ἐφ᾽ ὑμᾶς
traditions.VUL: Et post ómnia quæ venérunt super nos
traditions.KJV: And after all that is come upon us

13.english_reference: for our evil deeds , and for our great trespass

traditions.WLC: בְּ מַעֲשֵׂ֨י נוּ֙ הָ רָעִ֔ים וּ בְ אַשְׁמָתֵ֖ נוּ הַ גְּדֹלָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ἐν ποιήμασιν ὑμῶν τοῖς πονηροῖς καὶ ἐν πλημμελείᾳ ὑμῶν τῇ μεγάλῃ ·
traditions.VUL: in opéribus nostris péssimis , et in delícto nostro magno ,
traditions.KJV: for our evil deeds , and for our great trespass ,

13.english_reference: seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities [ deserve ]

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י נוּ חָשַׂ֤כְתָּֽ לְ מַ֨טָּה֙ מֵֽ עֲוֺנֵ֔ נוּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ὡς ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν , ὅτι ἐκούφισας ἡμῶν τὰς ἀνομίας
traditions.VUL: quia tu Deus noster liberásti nos de iniquitáte nostra ,
traditions.KJV: seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities [ deserve ] ,

13.english_reference: and hast given us [ such ] deliverance as this

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַ֥תָּה לָּ֛ נוּ פְּלֵיטָ֖ה כָּ זֹֽאת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκας ἡμῖν σωτηρίαν ·
traditions.VUL: et dedísti nobis salútem sicut est hódie ,
traditions.KJV: and hast given us [ such ] deliverance as this ;

14.english_reference: Should we again break thy commandments

traditions.WLC: הֲ נָשׁוּב֙ לְ הָפֵ֣ר מִצְוֺתֶ֔י ךָ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐπεστρέψαμεν διασκεδάσαι ἐντολάς σου
traditions.VUL: ut non converterémur , et írrita facerémus mandáta tua ,
traditions.KJV: Should we again break thy commandments ,

14.english_reference: and join in affinity with the people of these abominations ?

traditions.WLC: וּ֨ לְ הִתְחַתֵּ֔ן בְּ עַמֵּ֥י הַ תֹּעֵב֖וֹת הָ אֵ֑לֶּה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γαμβρεῦσαι τοῖς λαοῖς ·
traditions.VUL: neque matrimónia iungerémus cum pópulis abominatiónum istárum .
traditions.KJV: and join in affinity with the people of these abominations ?

14.english_reference: wouldest not thou be angry with us

traditions.WLC: הֲ ל֤וֹא תֶֽאֱנַף בָּ֨ נוּ֙
traditions.LXX: μὴ παροξυνθῇς ἐν ἡμῖν
traditions.VUL: Numquid irátus es nobis
traditions.KJV: wouldest not thou be angry with us

traditions.WLC: עַד כַּלֵּ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ἕως συντελείας
traditions.VUL: usque ad consummatiónem ,
traditions.KJV: till thou hadst consumed [ us ] ,

14.english_reference: so that [ there should be ] no remnant nor escaping ?

traditions.WLC: לְ אֵ֥ין שְׁאֵרִ֖ית וּ פְלֵיטָֽה
traditions.LXX: τοῦ μὴ εἶναι ἐνκατάλειμμα καὶ διασωζόμενον .
traditions.VUL: ne dimítteres nobis relíquias ad salútem ?
traditions.KJV: so that [ there should be ] no remnant nor escaping ?

traditions.WLC: יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙
traditions.LXX: Κύριε ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Dómine Deus Israel ,
traditions.KJV: O LORD God of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: צַדִּ֣יק אַ֔תָּה
traditions.LXX: δίκαιος σύ ,
traditions.VUL: iustus es tu :
traditions.KJV: thou [ art ] righteous :

15.english_reference: for we remain yet escaped , as [ it is ] this day

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי נִשְׁאַ֥רְנוּ פְלֵיטָ֖ה כְּ הַ יּ֣וֹם הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι κατελείφθημεν διασωζόμενοι ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη ·
traditions.VUL: quóniam derelícti sumus , qui salvarémur sicut die hac .
traditions.KJV: for we remain yet escaped , as [ it is ] this day :

15.english_reference: behold , we [ are ] before thee in our trespasses

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נ֤וּ לְ פָנֶ֨י ךָ֙ בְּ אַשְׁמָתֵ֔י נוּ
traditions.LXX: ἐναντίον σου ἐν πλημμελείαις ἡμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce coram te sumus in delícto nostro :
traditions.KJV: behold , we [ are ] before thee in our trespasses :

15.english_reference: for we can not stand before thee because of this

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין לַ עֲמ֛וֹד לְ פָנֶ֖י ךָ עַל זֹֽאת
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν στῆναι ἐνώπιόν σου ἐπὶ τούτῳ ·
traditions.VUL: non enim stari potest coram te super hoc .
traditions.KJV: for we can not stand before thee because of this .
